Prophecy: The Crown of Glory at the Chief Shepherd's Appearing
ProphecySummary: When the chief Shepherd appears, faithful elders who shepherded God's flock willingly and by example will receive a crown of glory that does not fade.
Fulfillment: Awaited: the chief Shepherd has not yet appeared in this sense, and the unfading crown is a future reward for faithful shepherding, distinct from the crown of life promised to all who endure.
